screen.title: Announcement: Lab relocation
screen.prompt: Listen to an announcement in a chemistry class.

audio.text: Good morning, everyone. As you know, the science building is being renovated this semester. Starting next Monday, all chemistry labs will move to the temporary rooms in the west annex. Lab times will not change, but please allow an extra ten minutes to walk there, since the annex is on the far side of campus. Safety goggles will no longer be provided, so bring your own.

options: Lab sessions will take place in a different building.
Lab sessions will start ten minutes later than they do now.
The chemistry course will be cancelled.
The west annex will be renovated.

why.en: The change (paraphrase). B distorts the time information.
why.es: El cambio (paráfrasis). B distorsiona la información sobre la hora.

questions.stem: What are students who used the lab's goggles told to do?
options: They can pick them up in the annex.
They will need to get goggles of their own.
They will arrive ten minutes later than usual.
They must move to a different lab time.
